_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (2/71 ±2 score moves) plus diverging momentum/DXY/funding vs Luna analog make HOLD the skilled call; no breaker confirmed.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst HOLD/CAUTION sideways vs narrative accumulation-bullish outflow story; lean analyst (7.67 trust)
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear/greed ~30-45, funding near flat next 1-2 sessions
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear/greed <25 with 30d momentum rolling over, or ETF flows + momentum lift score through ~46 into Complacency
